title: English Practice Quiz 0793
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 01: Before approaching an emergency scene,?
options: check that the scene is safe
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: check that the scene is safe.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 02: If a person is unresponsive,?
options: call emergency services and follow trained procedures
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: call emergency services and follow trained procedures.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 03: Severe bleeding requires?
options: urgent help and appropriate direct pressure if safe and trained
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: urgent help and appropriate direct pressure if safe and trained.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 04: A suspected fracture should be?
options: supported and kept still while help is arranged
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: supported and kept still while help is arranged.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 05: Possible stroke symptoms require?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: immediate emergency medical help.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 06: A first-aid kit should be?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: accessible, stocked and checked regularly.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 07: Disposable gloves should be used with?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: appropriate hand hygiene.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 08: A minor burn should receive?
options: cool running water and suitable assessment
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: cool running water and suitable assessment.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 09: A first aider should avoid?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: procedures beyond their training.

questions.question: First Aid and Health Awareness 10: After first aid, relevant details should be?
options: recorded and handed over according to policy
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: recorded and handed over according to policy.
